response.justification: Bogdan is a versatile, experienced full-stack/systems engineer with 15+ years across web, embedded, and distributed systems, but his background shows no direct experience with experimentation platforms, feature flagging, A/B testing, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, or growth engineering — the core focus of this role. His trajectory is generalist/full-stack rather than specialized in the data-driven experimentation and measurement systems the position demands, and there's no evidence of the cross-team platform leadership at the IC6/Principal scale described.
strengths: Extensive multi-domain engineering experience (web, mobile, embedded, distributed systems) over 15+ years
Demonstrated technical leadership, mentoring, and knowledge-sharing (workshops, talks, dojos)
Experience with high-throughput, low-latency systems at Dunnhumby/Sociomantic (millions of requests/sec)
concerns: No evidence of experimentation, A/B testing, feature-flagging, or growth/experimentation platform work
No demonstrated experience with telemetry/metrics systems, statistical analysis, or rollout-risk management
Career pattern is broad generalist/full-stack rather than showing progressive Principal-level systemic platform ownership across multiple teams

key_factors.factor: No telemetry, metrics, or data-driven analysis background
Strong general engineering depth and leadership/mentoring track record
